name: proof.memoryFieldIncrement.overflow-step-dropped.1
diff:
--- a/Solidity/Calculus/Rules.lean
+++ b/Solidity/Calculus/Rules.lean
@@ -591,3 +591,3 @@
   | memoryFieldIncrement :
-      dl{ ⟨[ mv.fld⊕⊕; ]⟩ ⇝ { memory := write(memory, mv.fld, mv.fld ± 1) } ⟨[ ]⟩ }
+      dl{ ⟨[ mv.fld⊕⊕; ]⟩ ⇝ { memory := write(memory, mv.fld, mv.fld) } ⟨[ ]⟩ }
   | memoryIndexArrayIncrement :

diagnostics.message:
Solidity.Taclet.memoryFieldIncrement: Tactic `rfl` failed: The left-hand side
  Stmt.step k✝ m✝ (Stmt.incDec op✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.mfield (MPath.var mv✝ hmv✝) fld✝ hfld✝))
is not definitionally equal to the right-hand side
  Premise.update
    (Upd.nil.snoc
      (UpdElem.memory
        (Tms.MTerm.write Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.field (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) fld✝ hfld✝)
          (Tms.MValT.val (Tms.Term.read Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.field (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) fld✝ hfld✝))))))

C✝ : Contract
k✝ : Nat
m✝ : Modality
Γ✝ : Ctx
p✝ : PrimTy
op✝ : IncDec
hp✝ : p✝.isNumeric = true
x✝ : Name
mv✝ : Idx Γ✝ (LTy.mem (RefTy.struct x✝))
hmv✝ : (Ty.ref (RefTy.struct x✝)).mapFree = true
fld✝ : Name
hfld✝ : C✝.fieldType x✝ fld✝ = some (Ty.prim p✝)
⊢ Stmt.step k✝ m✝ (Stmt.incDec op✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.mfield (MPath.var mv✝ hmv✝) fld✝ hfld✝)) =
    Premise.update
      (Upd.nil.snoc
        (UpdElem.memory
          (Tms.MTerm.write Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.field (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) fld✝ hfld✝)
            (Tms.MValT.val (Tms.Term.read Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.field (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) fld✝ hfld✝))))))
